text: This report recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law at 4231, 4237, and 4241 Dundas street West to permit the development of an 11 storey mixed use building with 318 residential units and 439 square metres of commercial at grade.

City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Zoning By-law 569-2013 for the lands municipally known as 4231, 4237 and 4241 Dundas Street West substantially in accordance with the draft Zoning By-law Amendment included as Attachment 5 to the report (June 16, 2025) from the Director, Community Planning, Etobicoke York District. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to make such stylistic and technical changes to the draft Zoning By-law Amendment as may be required.
